# League-2 Start/Sit Briefing -- Saturday, 2026-09-12 (Week 1)

**Final designations. Be decisive -- most of this roster kicks off tomorrow.**

## Source and freshness

**LIVE**, for the first time this season: `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` returned real week-1 data on this run (167 designations across the league; it raised a `ValueError` on every prior run through 2026-09-09). Data pulled 2026-09-12T06:13:43Z. Both Monday's and Wednesday's briefings fell back to a stale committed fixture -- this one did not.

Week confirmed as **1** via `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)`, cross-checked against `load_schedules(2026)`: 2 of 16 week-1 games are already final (Wed/Thu), the other 14 -- including every game on this roster -- are Sunday or Monday. ESPN, Sleeper and Rotowire were all proxy-blocked (403) as expected in this sandbox; news summarization and Rotowire annotations were skipped, and FantasyPros consensus was unavailable (no key), so every projection below comes from the in-house/week-1 model tier, run end-to-end through `generate_report.py` with the fitted `availability.py` model.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected pts | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Jaxson Dart | @DAL | **18.98** | 94% | 20.20 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs BAL | **15.33** | 91% | 16.94 |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | @DAL | **13.71** | 91% | 15.15 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs NE | **15.36** | 94% | 16.41 |
| WR | Drake London | @PIT | **13.46** | 94% | 14.38 |
| TE | Brock Bowers | vs MIA | **7.70** | 76% | 10.10 |
| FLEX | Bucky Irving | @CIN | **12.26** | 91% | 13.54 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | @TB | **10.86** | 88% | 12.34 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | vs ARI | **8.94** | 97% | 9.22 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | vs WAS | **8.32** | 100% | 8.32 |
| **Total** | | | **124.92** | | |

Bench (expected-pts order): Jameson Williams WR (9.29), Quentin Johnston WR (8.47), Josh Downs WR (7.32), Harold Fannin Jr. TE (5.50), Matthew Stafford QB (15.79, no usable slot behind Dart).

Bowers is the one start on faith here: no formal Friday tag, but knee + DNP all week per the live report. Start him anyway -- Fannin's ceiling (6.14 if he plays) doesn't come close even at Bowers' 76% floor.

## Changes since Wednesday (2026-09-09)

| Action | Player | Replacing | Δ expected | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Start | Tee Higgins | Harold Fannin Jr. | +1.06 vs Fannin's updated number (+5.36 vs Fannin's own live-run projection) | First live practice/injury data of the season. Higgins: Full participation, no designation -- clears Wednesday's 0.519 placeholder decisively. |
| Bench | Harold Fannin Jr. | -- | -- | Held FLEX2 since Wednesday on a stale, narrative-only number. |
| Bench | Jameson Williams | -- | -- | Still the top bench WR (9.29) but outclassed by the rest of the lineup. |

Lineup total **124.92**, down from Wednesday's 133.22 (-8.30). That drop is almost entirely Brock Bowers' newly-surfaced knee/DNP status (13.96 -> 7.70) and Jonathan Taylor settling lower on a fresh model fit (17.06 -> 15.33); Higgins clearing into FLEX2 offsets only part of it.

## Watch list

| Player | Why | When |
|---|---|---|
| Brock Bowers | Knee, DNP all week, **no formal game designation** -- unusual this late. Model already prices it (76% play), but this is the single biggest risk in the lineup with no bench replacement. | Inactives list, ~90 min before LV @ MIA Sunday |
| Cameron Dicker | Was Questionable most of the week; live feed shows no designation now and 97% play probability. Resolved. | Already resolved |

One data-quality note worth flagging: the report's `newsFlag.designation` field still reads "Healthy" for both Higgins and Bowers -- that comes from ESPN/Sleeper news scraping, both proxy-blocked here, so it never saw either player's real practice report. The play-probability *model* did consume the real nflreadpy data directly, so the numbers above are trustworthy even though that one label lags.

## Opponent notes

- **Jaxon Smith-Njigba (SEA vs NE)** kicks off first among this roster's games -- lock that slot early if your platform allows staggered swaps.
- **Brock Bowers vs MIA** -- no defensive matchup news changes the outlook; the entire risk here is Bowers' own knee, not the opponent.

## Byes ahead

None in weeks 1-3 -- clear through week 5. First cluster is **week 6** (Tee Higgins, Jameson Williams) and **week 7** (Cameron Dicker -- the only rostered K -- and Quentin Johnston). Five bench spots is thin for two K/WR-heavy bye weeks back to back; start scouting waiver kickers and WRs once week 1 results are in.

## Caveats

- First briefing on a genuinely live injury/practice source (see Source and freshness).
- Only Higgins and Bowers appear in the live injury report; everyone else is undesignated.
- `newsFlag.designation` reads "Healthy" for Higgins and Bowers due to blocked ESPN/Sleeper scraping -- trust the play-probability numbers, not that label.
- Lineup total moved mostly on Bowers' newly-surfaced risk and a Taylor re-fit, not on the Higgins/Fannin flex swap alone.
- Report regenerated into a scratch directory via `generate_report.py`; the committed `weekly-report-week-1.json` fixture was not touched, per this routine's narrow write scope.
